name: E-Tafkeek — TAFKEEK e-Waste Recycling
address: Mecca Street, Al Husseini complex 152, 4th floor, office 402
process: Call the mobile number and tell them roughly how many devices you have.
Send pictures of the devices so they can estimate the load.
They send a car to your location to collect the components.
accepts: Motherboards, PC cards and PCB boards
services: Free pickup by car after a call and photos (confirm timing when you call)
Refurbished computers and usable parts (hard drives, optical drives, RAM)
Non-recycled boards (motherboards, PC cards, PCB) for export
Legal disposal supporting the MOENV 100 JOD/ton fee policy
notes: You do not need to travel to the office: call the mobile, describe the rough count, and send photos — they arrange a car to your location. The two +962 6 numbers are landlines for the office. Ask what happens to data-bearing drives before handing anything over.

name: Al Nasser Group — E-Waste Management
address: 7th Circle, Al Husseini Complex, 5th floor, office 512
process: Call or request a quote — they collect from businesses, households, schools and government agencies.
They transport the e-waste with specialised vehicles to their processing facility.
Ask explicitly for data destruction: wiping or physical destruction of HDD, SSD and memory cards.
Components are recovered; the rest is recycled, and reusable devices may be refurbished and resold or donated.
accepts: Hard drives, SSDs and memory cards
services: Collection and transportation from businesses, households, schools and government agencies
Secure data destruction: wiping and physical destruction of hard drives, SSDs and memory cards
Component recovery: metals, plastics and circuit boards
Recycling and refurbishment; reusable devices resold or donated for reuse
Environmental compliance with local and international regulations
notes: Only a landline is published on the site (+962 6 5833 166). Ask whether they collect a single household device or only bulk loads, and request data destruction explicitly — their site offers wiping and physical destruction, which pairs with Fahas's wipe attestation. Sales address listed on the site: Sales2@nassergroup.com.jo. Map: https://maps.app.goo.gl/Fvz8bBdvUZLFJYUz9
